head: working-tree
subject: LRS scheduler overall deadline bounds the report wait
change: Scheduler.run now caps its socket wait at the caller's overall deadline as well as the server's next report boundary. A long server-advertised report interval can no longer make runWithTimeout/runWithControlPlaneTimeout overrun the application budget. The focused loopback test advertises a 10-second interval, gives the scheduler 100 ms, and asserts error.Timeout within one second.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/lrs/scheduler_tests.zig 'gRPC LRS scheduler timeout bounds a long report interval' uses a real LRS duplex peer, a 10-second advertised interval and a 100 ms scheduler budget.

notes: This makes the scheduler deadline-correct for a future controller-owned background runner. Automatic LRS scheduling and authority-specific control planes remain open.
